remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. The verso inscription refers to sculptor Mary Callery, a close friend of the artist. Callery made a sculpture portrait of O'Keeffe in the 1940s. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A faintly drawn, craggy hill stretches across the horizontal composition. The soft form is set against the plain white surface of the paper.
